question: What power of form arises for one whose mind is absorbed in one-pointed meditation?
premises: The practitioner’s mind becomes absorbed in one-pointed meditation.
From this state a power to produce form arises.
That form can be manifested in many ways.
inference: Therefore, one-pointed meditative absorption enables the creation of manifold forms.
plain_english: One whose mind is absorbed in one-pointed meditation can assume forms in many ways.
